item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: The Apple of His Eye
item.description: Based on everything you can see, feel, or understand, your circumstances look bad. So, what is your next step? You can cower in fear. You can bury your head in the sand, ignore, and hope it gets better. You can plot and plan your strategy to fight against the real or seeming injustice of your situation. item.description: The late radio teacher, J. item.title: Library event offers dessert for breakfast
item.description: H. Grady Bradshaw Library will host a free ice-cream-for-breakfast event with crafts on Feb. 7 at 10:30 a.m.; registration is required by Feb. 6.

item.title: Wildcat 5K to return to Lanett
item.description: Springwood School's Wildcat 5K Color Run and 1 Mile Fun Run return March 21 in Lanett, offering prizes by age group, community fun and fundraising for athletics.

item.title: West Point bringing back Arbor Day tree giveaway
item.description: West Point to give away 100 free trees to residents Feb. 20, 10 a.m.–noon at City Hall, first-come first-served, two per person with proof of residency.

item.title: VPD officers recognized with rank promotions
item.description: Valley council promotes three police officers to captain, buys 8.2-acre Fob James Dr. tract and approves first Community Center membership rate hike under Mayor Riley.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: The Winter Storm of ‘93
item.description: It looks like we dodged the storm down here in L.A. (Lower Alabama). Much of our nation is caught in the grip of more snow and ice than they’ve seen in a while. item.title: AHSAA reclassifies high school teams for next school year
item.description: AHSAA drops its seven-class system, creates separate public and private divisions, and shifts Chambers County teams into new regions for 2026-28.

item.title: LaFayette City Council explores grant writing
item.description: LaFayette council taps a consultant to demystify grant writing, tie funding to economic growth, and set 30–90 day goals aligned with its new comprehensive plan.
